hero.title:
We began inside
this community.
hero.description:
The United States offers many housing and social supports for lower-income families.
Yet language barriers, complicated processes, and not knowing whom to ask leave many Korean-American households without benefits they’re entitled to.

HapVi Together was founded within the LA Korean community to close that gap.

Like our name—Happy Village Together—
building a better village together is where we start.

paragraphs: HapVi blends “Happy” and “Village,” reflecting our vision of a village where everyone can thrive.
The name is more than words—it’s a promise toward a better tomorrow.
Change begins with each of us.
Through education, housing, and healthier environments, HapVi Together helps individuals and families live fuller lives.
Together, we can build a stronger village and a sustainable future.
Now—let’s build a happier village together.

mission.label: Mission
body: You don't need to have it all figured out. Just knowing things are hard right now — that's enough.
No worries about language, immigration status, or cost.
Just reach out first. We'll work through the rest together.

Eligibility.title: Check Your Eligibility
Eligibility.metaDescription: Screen for Section 8, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, LIHEAP, and emergency rental assistance.

hero.description: Answer 4 questions to see which benefits you may qualify for. For guidance only—not an official determination.

household.title: Household size
household.description: Select everyone living in your home, including yourself.

income.title: Monthly household income
income.description: Select your household’s total monthly income before taxes.

housing.title: Current housing
housing.description: Choose the option that best describes where you live now.

immigration.title: U.S. immigration status
immigration.citizenLpr: U.S. citizen or green card holder

results.title: Your results
results.description: Based on your answers. Each agency makes the final eligibility decision.

results.noneEligible: No programs matched your answers. Contact us for a free consultation.

rejectReasons.income_too_high: Monthly income appears above this program’s typical limit.
rejectReasons.not_renting: This program is for households that are currently renting.
rejectReasons.immigration_required: May require U.S. citizenship, green card, or lawful status.
rejectReasons.immigration_uncertain: Immigration status needs to be confirmed.

section8.name: Section 8 / HCV (Housing Voucher)
section8.summary: Rent assistance for low-income households through LA County HACLA.

calfresh.name: CalFresh (SNAP food benefits)
calfresh.summary: EBT benefits to help buy groceries.

medi-cal.name: Medi-Cal (Health coverage)
medi-cal.summary: Free or low-cost health coverage in California.

liheap.name: LIHEAP (Utility assistance)
liheap.summary: Help paying electric, gas, and energy bills.

emergency-rental.name: Emergency Rental Assistance
emergency-rental.summary: Emergency help with rent when facing eviction or arrears.

Eligibility.disclaimer: Income limits are scaled from a 4-person household baseline for guidance only—not a legal or official decision.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: HapVi Together (“we,” “our organization”) values your privacy and complies with applicable laws. This policy explains how we handle information collected through our website and consultation requests.
s1Items: Name and contact information (phone number or email)
s2Items: To provide housing support and public benefits counseling
To share service information and follow up with you
s3Items: We retain records for three years after a consultation is completed
We delete information promptly upon request when applicable
s4Items: We do not share your information with third parties as a rule
Exceptions may apply where required by law
Privacy.s5Lead: We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to understand how visitors use our site.
Privacy.s5LinksIntro: Learn more using the links below.
Privacy.s5LinkGaOptOutLabel: Opt out of GA4 collection (browser add-on)
Privacy.s5CookieNote: You can also disable cookies in your browser settings.
s6Items: Our services are not directed to children under 13
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13
If we learn we have collected such information, we will delete it promptly
s7Items: We aim to respond within 30 days of your request
We may need to verify your identity
s8Items: Address: 540 S. Normandie Ave #203, Los Angeles, CA 90020
s9Paragraphs: We may notify you of material changes via our website or email.
Continued use of our services after changes may mean you accept the updated policy.
